purpose: Image-only, independent Task 15I descriptor inference for candidate-pair construction.
scientific_boundary: This execution may read only image_id, image_path_relative, and content_sha256 from the input manifest. It must not read human outcomes, identity labels, calibration outcomes, deployment-confirmation outcomes, or mechanism-confirmation outcomes.
failure_policy: Fail the entire run on any manifest, file-integrity, image-decode, model-load, embedding, or output-validation error. Do not silently drop or replace images.
claim_boundary: A successful run supplies only reproducible descriptor embeddings and directed candidate memberships. It is not an identity conclusion, a model-performance claim, or a Task 15I pass decision.
